description: One grouped PR per week for everything non-major; majors arrive on their own and wait for a human.
Some version strings in this repo are deliberately left unmanaged, and a rule for any of them would do harm rather than nothing:
ENVTEST_VERSION and ENVTEST_K8S_VERSION in the Makefile derive themselves from go.mod through a shell function, so a Renovate rule would fight the Makefile and lose on the next go.mod bump.
The pgcopydb and postgresql-client-18 apt packages in images/runner/Dockerfile float inside their majors on purpose (hadolint ignore=DL3008), and a build-time canary fails the image on major drift.
GitHub Actions pins float on major tags on purpose, so no digest pinning: config:recommended leaves pinDigests off, which is what we want.

ignorePaths repeats the config:recommended default minus **/test/**, because that glob hides the e2e operator pin in test/e2e/e2e_suite_test.go and a custom manager that matches nothing fails silently. Everything else under test/ is Go tests and SQL fixtures, so nothing new becomes visible.

packageRules.description: Low-risk updates land on their own once CI is green.
Majors need a human to read the changelog, so label them and leave them.
The chart points at our own images, whose tags come from the release tag via appVersion. Scoped to helm-values so the e2e pin below, which shares a depName, keeps updating.

customManagers.description: mkdocs-material is pinned in two workflows and in the runner image, and all three must agree: the docs build and the staleness gate compare renderings.
crd-ref-docs generates docs/reference/api.md; the Taskfile and the docs workflow MUST install the same version or the staleness gate fails on a rendering diff.
golangci-lint: the Makefile installs it, .custom-gcl.yml rebuilds it with plugins, and a mismatch fails the custom build.
kustomize tags releases as kustomize/vX.Y.Z, so the go datasource is the one that reports a bare v5.8.1: the module lives in a subdirectory and the proxy already strips the prefix.
The e2e suite installs a released operator image. Bumping this by hand after every release is the chore this rule retires.
The runner image pins its tools so the image is reproducible and a bump is visible. Merging one rebuilds the image, because github-runner-image.yml watches this file.
